subject.title: feat: let plugins control inbound debounce policy

question: Should OpenClaw solve per-conversation WhatsApp debounce with the bounded WhatsApp configuration contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100970, or publish this new generic `inbound_debounce` plugin API?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same user problem but create materially different long-term public contracts; source review cannot safely choose the product boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Choose WhatsApp-owned configuration
options.body: Sponsor the bounded per-conversation configuration proposal and avoid publishing a generic plugin ingress-policy hook for a single current channel.

options.title: Sponsor the generic hook
options.body: Accept this public plugin API only after documenting its cross-channel contract, demonstrating an installed WhatsApp plugin, and resolving the competing configuration proposal.

options.title: Defer both contracts
options.body: Pause the feature until a broader channel-policy design establishes why a public hook is preferable to channel-owned configuration.

recommendation.title: Choose WhatsApp-owned configuration
recommendation.body: Sponsor the bounded per-conversation configuration proposal and avoid publishing a generic plugin ingress-policy hook for a single current channel.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidenced repository member currently engaged on the contract discussion.
